claim: Can available original-object evidence establish local stroke order or a separate later engraving episode for Greek groups?
scope: Exploratory source/report and photograph audit only; no verified unused observation, absolute dating, deposit-removal meaning, hand identity or identification claim.

claims_separated.A: Replicate exact published assertion: subject, local datum, measurement type and uncertainty.
claims_separated.B: Local relative order at an authenticated Greek-Hebrew/value crossing.
claims_separated.C: Distinct later episode requires an independent intervening alteration/event bridging mark sets; local order alone insufficient.
claims_separated.D: Removed-deposit meaning requires additional independent evidence even if C supported.

reading_rule: Retain every edition alternative. Cancelled I belongs to correction inspection, not an active initial. No reading choice by temporal fit.
windows: For each locus inspect full target line and one full line above/below, preserving source boundaries; deduplicate overlapping windows. Adjacent Hebrew/value signs are matched local controls. I12 has no printed amount: amount comparison inapplicable. Precise line-to-cut registration is unknown until anchored; do not silently assign cuts from glyph fit.

primary_report_targets.Tov: Copper Scroll Studies chapter20 pp288–290, report p289. Inherited broader subject KEN plus preceding Hebrew word; 2mm datum/type unverified.
primary_report_targets.Puech: IV2 cancelled I/deeper report: exact edition page and observation basis unrecovered. Greek-Greek correction alone not Hebrew-Greek order.

local_order_criterion: Authentic preserved groove intersection with truncation/reworking of earlier edges or floor, identifiable parent strokes, known metal-side and provenance, no modern scratch/corrosion/casting ambiguity. Require at least two documented light directions or calibrated geometry, and two independent readers agreeing on physical mechanism before temporal interpretation. This yields only local order.
episode_criterion: Original groove sets placed on opposite sides of an independently authenticated intervening event. Same/different tool, hand, depth, line position or general corrosion color alone cannot establish an episode interval.
difference_fields: incision depth relative to local sheet
metrology: No invented depth cutoff. Numeric replication requires documented scale/calibration/resolution/datum/repeatability before measurement. Ordinary photographs/RTI are not metricheight. Original surface can be masked or altered by corrosion, stress, cuts, cleaning, consolidants and replica manufacture.
terminal_rule: Supported relative to registered alternatives only for authenticated local relations; an authenticated reverse crossing rejects corresponding local-order claim. Missing/no crossing/unreadable/unknown provenance or metrology => not identifiable. Absence of depth contrast cannot reject separate episode. C/D stay not identifiable without their extra bridge. Limited source coverage cannot reject or establish all seven as a universal last-engraved layer.
exposure: All groups, named reports and prior drawings are exposed. New copies of known features are not automatically holdouts. Protocol precedes any new targetimage review this turn; source textual methods and catalog metadata already explored. No confirmatory unseen prediction registered.
accounting: Freeze adds no inspected source count, bounded test, identification, confidence, coordinates, field campaign or question closure.
freeze_commit: Publish before targetimage review; immutable commit will be recorded with results.
